Para entrar em contato, utilize o formulário abaixo.

<form action="https://formspree.io/f/xgvgnnpp" method="POST">

::: mb-3
<label class="form-label">Nome</label> <input
type="text"
name="name"
class="form-control"
required>
:::

::: mb-3
<label class="form-label">E-mail</label> <input
type="email"
name="email"
class="form-control"
required>
:::

::: mb-3
<label class="form-label">Instituição</label> <input
type="text"
name="institution"
class="form-control">
:::

::: mb-3
<label class="form-label">Assunto</label> <input
type="text"
name="subject"
class="form-control"
required>
:::

::: mb-3
<label class="form-label">Mensagem</label>

```{=html}
<textarea
name="message"
rows="6"
class="form-control"
required></textarea>
```
:::

<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">

Enviar

</button>

</form>
